title: Static logo proposals
intro: Review one explicit image request, approve its estimate, then inspect the private PNG before selecting an identity draft slot.
scope: Static PNG only: one image per approval. No reference images, SVG, GIF or animation. Separate logo variants require separate reviewed requests. Nothing is applied live here.
cost_warning: This is an estimate, not a guaranteed total or provider-enforced spending cap. Input charges, account pricing and actual billing may differ. Unknown estimates block generation. No automatic paid retry occurs.
payload: Exact outbound JSON — no hidden site content
approve: I reviewed this exact request and estimate, and approve one potentially billable image generation.
private: This proposal is accessible only through authenticated owner access. It expires after 30 minutes; restarting discards it. Review text, clarity and suitability yourself.
light_preview: Same PNG on a light background
dark_preview: Same PNG on a dark background
size_preview: 16/32/64px size previews of the same PNG; these are not separately designed favicon or dark-logo assets.
public_note: Selecting imports this PNG into the media library, where its URL can be publicly readable even before Apply. Only the selected draft slot changes; live identity remains unchanged. Selection makes a local 512×512 logo derivative, or 64×64 for the site icon, preserving alpha without recoloring or another paid request. These are size derivatives, not independent designs.
prompt_help: Only this prompt and the displayed model/size/quality/background are sent. No site title, content, current logos or reference images are included automatically.
permission: This action also requires media.upload permission.
adapter_help: A listed model or successful text connection does not prove image support. Explicitly declare OpenAI-compatible images-png-v1 support for this exact saved model and maintain an image estimate including its assumptions. Only public HTTPS endpoints are supported; private/local provider endpoints are unavailable in this version. No discovery or generation call occurs when saving. Native Anthropic image generation is not implemented.
transparent: Transparent (only if supported by this model)
basis: Estimate basis, including input costs and limitations
no_profiles: No valid saved AI profiles are available.
config_saved: Adapter declaration saved locally; no provider was called.
draft_saved: Logo slot saved in the identity draft. Review and apply separately in Identity Studio.
import_conflict: The PNG was imported into media, but the identity changed and the draft was not modified. The new media ID is retained for review; no shared media was deleted.
error_approval: Approval was missing, expired or already consumed. Review the exact request again before approving.
error_changed: The connection, estimate, capability, active theme or draft changed. Nothing was sent or overwritten; review again.
error_provider: Generation failed or its outcome is uncertain. There is no automatic retry. Check the provider before approving another request to avoid duplicate charges.
error_candidate: The private proposal is unavailable or belongs to another session owner.
error_limit: Private staging is full. Wait for proposals to expire before generating more.
error_unavailable: No supported PNG adapter with a current known estimate is available, or the supplied fields are invalid. Check the saved profile, declaration, currency and estimate ceiling.
